dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Then could I trouble you to make a Lohikeitto? A guest specifically requested it today. Said they wanted to reminisce on the taste of the "past."

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: But I... I'm starting to forget what that "past" tasted like. Would you help me? I promise the reward will be worth your while.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: This aroma, and the color too... it really takes me back. I'll deliver it to the guest at once.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: #With this as a reference, I shouldn't need to trouble you again next time. Thank you so much, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Mm... These are all common Mondstadt staples, but I ordered Lohikeitto today.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: I certainly never expected a dish I couldn't find any fault with... Hmm, I wonder... Did they hire a new chef?
